description: Key set with its last segment capitalized
settles: That a path below the root is matched without regard to case: the key set answers to JWKS as readily as to jwks. Both tenant segments above it are compared exactly (CAP-007, CAP-008), so this broker splits where the first one does - an exact prefix selecting the application, and looser matching beneath it. StubID matches below the root the way ASP.NET routing does, which agrees.
